text:
Predicates:
ResidentialCollege(x) ::: x is a residential college at Yale.
At(y, x) ::: y is located at x.
YaleUniversity ::: Yale University.
PiersonCollege ::: Pierson College.
Premises:
YaleUniversity ∧ (∃x (ResidentialCollege(x) ∧ At(PiersonCollege, x))) ::: Yale University has Pierson College as a residential college.
Conclusion:
ResidentialCollege(PiersonCollege) ::: Pierson College is a residential college at Yale.
